en.purpose: To record morphology and immunohistochemical findings relevant for subtyping lung cancer according to current national guidelines.
en.use: Used during pathological assessment of lung tumor tissue. Supports diagnostic classification into adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, small-cell lung cancer, or other subtypes.
en.misuse: Not intended for molecular genetic testing or treatment planning. Do not use for non-lung tumors.

other_details.references:
Regionala cancercentrum i samverkan. Nationellt vårdprogram lungcancer. Kunskapsbanken, 2025.
Available at: kunskapsbanken.cancercentrum.se/diagnoser/lungcancer/vardprogram/
other_details.en: A clinical decision guideline for classifying the histopathological subtype of lung cancer in patients with suspected or confirmed malignancy, based on tumor morphology and immunohistochemical markers such as TTF-1, p40, CK5/6, synaptophysin, chromogranin A, and Ki-67.
